identity.title: Keep duplicate Pipeline Review Step rows distinct by run-scoped index

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and source review
origin.summary: 2D-011 requires duplicate Step names and identical layer routes to retain the correct Review row, metric, NG reason, execution order, and intermediate image when only parameters differ.

state.current_summary: Pipeline Review now keys summaries and intermediate output images by the ordered Step index of the current Run. Duplicate Name/Tool/InputLayer/OutputLayer rows keep distinct metrics and acceptance decisions, reordering and disabled steps remain aligned, and the selected document row requests its exact Step-index output while the legacy layer-only lookup remains latest-output compatible.

claims.text: The prior AreSameStep comparison used Name, ToolType, InputLayer, and OutputLayer, CompleteRun selected the first Step by Name and OutputLayer, and review output images were cached by output-layer name only. Duplicate rows with different parameters could therefore collapse into the wrong summary or overwrite one another's preview.

problem.impact: A beginner reviewing a pipeline could see a metric, NG reason, or intermediate image belonging to a different duplicate Step, and editing or reordering a Step could make historical evidence appear to move between rows.

criteria.text: Review execution maps each run result and source Step to its ordered run-scoped Step index without Name/route first-match fallback, preserving execution order and disabled/skipped state.
Intermediate output images are retained per Step index even when output layers are identical; selecting a Review row requests its exact image, while the existing layer-only lookup remains compatible.

Duplicate identity, same-route output, metric/NG, reorder, disabled, execution-generation, cache-lifetime, and stale-callback contracts pass with a focused Debug build and no Original repository or external mutation.

context.location: OpenVisionPipelineReviewExecutionController owns run generation, Step-index summaries, and per-Step cached output; OpenVisionPipelineReviewLayerImageOwner owns preview lookup conversion; OpenVisionPipelineReviewDocument.SelectStep owns the selected-row request; PipelineReviewDuplicateStepIdentityContract owns the focused corpus contract.
The execution controller writes mutable run/result and image-cache state; the document only selects and presents a Step; no new serializer or persisted GUID state was introduced.

OpenVisionPipelineReviewExecutionController.cs -> OpenVisionPipelineReviewLayerImageOwner.cs -> OpenVisionPipelineReviewDocument.cs -> PipelineReviewDuplicateStepIdentityContract.cs -> stable feature contracts and current handoff.

evidence.observation: Source review confirms Dictionary<int,...> summary/image state, source/effective pipeline index resolution, exact Step-index output lookup, and removal of Name/route first-match and layer-only cache ownership from the selected-row path.

Focused contract passed. Two Steps with identical Name/Tool/InputLayer/OutputLayer but different constants retained separate summaries; Step 2 kept its OutputWidth NG reason, both output pixels remained distinct, layer-only lookup returned the latest output, and reorder and disabled cases preserved separate identities.

Existing Review execution-generation, cached-image replacement/reset/close lifetime, stale callback atomic-application, and document revision/selection guard contracts all passed after the identity change.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug build completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors. No desktop EXE or WPF UI interaction was launched in this slice; theme, DPI, monitor, and native hardware coverage remain unverified.

events.summary: Reuse the existing Review execution controller and document/layer-image owner. Use the current Run's ordered Step index as the minimal stable identity; do not add a GUID serializer migration or a second mapping service.
PL-0069 resolved after the duplicate identity contract and existing Review lifecycle regressions passed with the focused Debug build; no Original or external mutation was performed.
